name: meridian
description: Build, bill and deploy Shopify apps on Meridian: the Meridian MCP server plus a skill for the CLI, the SDK and hosting.

interface.shortDescription: Build, bill and deploy Shopify apps on Meridian
interface.longDescription: Meridian is a platform for Shopify app developers. This plugin connects the Meridian MCP server, so the agent reads your app's real plans, feature keys, deployments, logs and webhook routes, and adds a skill that teaches it to use the Meridian CLI, wire @the-meridian/sdk into a Shopify app (pricing page, feature gating, usage tracking) and deploy on Meridian hosting. Sign-in, API keys and secrets stay with you, and the agent asks before a production deploy, a rollback or a database reset.
defaultPrompt: Add Meridian billing to this Shopify app, with a pricing page and a feature gate
Get this app running locally on my Meridian developer database
Why did the last production deploy of my app fail?
